corruptions.text:
Pashtun diaspora refers to ethnic Pashtuns who live outside of their traditional homeland of Pashtunistan, specifically in countries such as Pakistan and other parts of Asia and Europe, including Afghanistan, Central Asia, and some Southeast Asian countries. This means that the largest community of Pashtun migrants exist within Pakistan. 

FINDING: Largest community of Pashtuns exists in Pakistan.
